name: wrs-raipur-spring-system
description: Indian Railways WRS Raipur Spring Classification & Wagon QC System (Phase 1 & Phase 2)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start:live: npm run seed && concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.demo: npm run seed && concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,TUNNEL" -c "blue,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:5173"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client

author: Indian Railways WRS Raipur
